exposure: Placental miRNA expression (specifically miRNA-371b-3p and miRNA-3940-3p)
cohort: The study included 132 mothers undergoing elective cesarean sections from whom placentas and fasting blood samples were collected at delivery.
finding: Placental miRNA-3940-3p expression remained significantly associated with maternal insulin resistance (HOMA-IR) at delivery, even after adjusting for confounding variables.
